newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-NAVRATILOVA CALLS FOR RETURN TO WOODEN RACKETS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-NAVRATILOVA CALLS FOR RETURN TO WOODEN RACKETS.

text.p: Nine-times Wimbledon champion Martina Navratilova has called for a return to wooden rackets in order to revive spectator interest in tennis.
"We are not going to get finesse with these big rackets," the American former world number one said in a televison interview.
"Go back to wooden rackets. Baseball is not played with aluminium bats.
"If they played with all this space-age material in major league baseball we would have home run derby."
